title: Data Scientist -100k
description:
Data Scientist - 100K

Newcastle upon Tyne

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Data Scientist to join a highly skilled analytics team working at the intersection of data, technology and business decision-making.

This role offers the chance to work with a broad range of structured, unstructured and alternative datasets, transforming complex information into actionable insights that directly influence strategic and commercial decisions. You'll collaborate closely with business stakeholders, leveraging advanced analytical techniques, machine learning and forecasting models to solve challenging real-world problems.

The Role

You will:

  • Develop data-driven forecasts using statistical and machine learning techniques
  • Analyse large and complex datasets to uncover trends and actionable insights
  • Design and maintain automated data pipelines and reporting solutions
  • Build intuitive visualisations and self-service analytics tools
  • Support stakeholders in making better decisions through data
  • Contribute to best practices in data science, analytics and software development
  • Work closely with technical and non-technical teams on high-impact initiatives
  • Continuously improve analytical processes and methodologies

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics or a related field
  • Strong Python and SQL skills in a production environment
  • Experience building forecasting models and working with time-series data
  • Solid understanding of statistics and machine learning techniques
  • Ability to communicate complex analytical findings to business stakeholders
  • Experience working with large datasets and solving complex data challenges
  • Strong problem-solving skills and excellent attention to detail


Desirable Skills

  • Azure cloud technologies
  • Databricks
  • Data visualisation and dashboard development
  • Experience building automated analytics solutions

What's On Offer?

  • Work on varied and intellectually challenging data projects
  • Opportunity to influence key business decisions
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and methodologies
  • Collaborative and high-performing team environment
  • Significant ownership and autonomy from day one
  • Continued learning and professional development opportunities
  • Competitive salary + Bonus
